intro_html:
The best mattress in the UAE is the one that suits how you sleep and copes with the heat. So instead of one "number one", we've picked the best mattress for each kind of sleeper: back and front sleepers, side sleepers, hot sleepers, couples, kids, and anyone who wants a 5-star hotel bed at home.

Every pick is one we stand behind: free delivery across the UAE in 2–3 working days, a 100-night sleep trial so you can decide at home rather than in a showroom, and 4 interest-free payments with Tabby or Tamara. Below each mattress you'll see who it's best for. Still torn? Read our guide to choosing the best mattress in the UAE, or take the 60-second mattress finder.

How we pick. We look at three things: support for the way you sleep, how the materials cope with UAE heat, and honest value for the price. Back and front sleepers need a firmer surface to keep the spine level. Side sleepers need give at the shoulder and hip. Hot sleepers need springs, latex or gel foam that let air move.

seo_description: Firm, supportive medical mattresses in the UAE, 90x200 to 200x200 cm. Pocket spring core, free delivery in 2–3 days and a 100-night trial.
intro_html:
In the UAE, "medical mattress" usually means a firm, supportive mattress that keeps the spine level instead of letting you sink in. That's what you'll find here: firm pocket-spring mattresses with high-density foam edges, from 90 × 200 to 200 × 200 cm.

A medical mattress isn't a medical device, and no mattress treats a health condition. If you have back, neck or joint pain, ask your doctor or physiotherapist what kind of support they recommend, then choose the firmness that matches. Our Hotel Collection Tight Top is rated 9/10 firm. For a slightly softer surface with the same support, see our orthopaedic mattresses.

Free delivery across all seven emirates, a 100-night sleep trial, and 4 interest-free payments with Tabby or Tamara.

Check the size and height. Firmer mattresses are usually deeper. If you or someone you care for finds it hard to get in and out of bed, check the mattress height on the product page against your bed frame, and message us on WhatsApp if you're unsure.
